IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: TO PROVIDE EDUCATIONAL, SCIENTIFIC AND LEGISLATIVE INFORMATION TO THE PUBLIC AND GOVERNMENT.
IRS990.MissionDesc: FEDERATION OF AMERICAN SCIENTISTS (FAS) IS A NONPARTISAN ORGANIZATION LOCATED IN THE DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA. FAS EMBEDS SCIENCE, TECHNOLOGY, INNOVATION, AND EXPERIENCE INTO GOVERNMENT AND PUBLIC DISCOURSE IN ORDER TO BUILD A HEALTHY, SAFE, PROSPEROUS, AND EQUITABLE SOCIETY.
IRS990.Desc: FISCAL SPONSORSHIPS (FORMERLY KNOWN AS SPECIAL PROJECTS): A HOME FOR INITIATIVES THAT BRING SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY TO BEAR ON CRITICAL POLICY CHALLENGES. THE PROGRAM IS DESIGNED TO ADDRESS A CONTINUING LONG-TERM CHALLENGE: ENSURING THAT HIGH IMPACT SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY PROJECTS FOR THE PUBLIC GOOD HAVE THE OPERATIONAL INFRASTRUCTURE, FINANCIAL SUSTAINABILITY, AND STRATEGIC SUPPORT THEY NEED TO LAUNCH QUICKLY, OPERATE RESPONSIBLY, AND DEMONSTRATE MEASURABLE PUBLIC BENEFIT. IN FY2025, FAS ACCEPTED TAX-DEDUCTIBLE CONTRIBUTIONS ON BEHALF OF SPONSORED NINE PROJECTS AND PROVIDED FINANCIAL OVERSIGHT, COMPLIANCE, AND ADMINISTRATIVE INFRASTRUCTURE INCLUDING SUPPORTING THE ALLIANCE FOR LEARNING INNOVATION (ALI) AS IT DEVELOPED AN INDEPENDENT OPERATING MODEL, SUPPORTED BY SIX PHILANTHROPIES.

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: TALENT INITIATIVES: FELLOWSHIP PROGRAMS THAT CULTIVATE POLICY ENTREPRENEURSHIP SKILLS AMONG SCIENTIFIC AND TECHNICAL (S&T) TALENT AND DEPLOY EXPERTS INTO PUBLIC SERVICE TO MAKE PROGRESS ON THE MOST IMPORTANT S&T CHALLENGES OF OUR TIME. IN FY2025, FAS CONTINUED TO MANAGE FELLOWSHIPS ACROSS THE FEDERAL GOVERNMENT, INCLUDING AT THE US DEPARTMENT OF AGRICULTURE WHERE FELLOWS BRIDGED THE GAPS BETWEEN POLICY DESIGN AND PRACTICAL IMPLEMENTATION, PARTICULARLY FOR RURAL AND TRIBAL FARMING COMMUNITIES. ADDITIONALLY, FAS EXPANDED THE TALENT INITIATIVES PROGRAM TO PROVIDE FELLOWSHIPS INTO CIVIL SOCIETY ORGANIZATIONS SUPPORTING 10 FELLOWS WORKING ON ENERGY AFFORDABILITY, DIGITAL TRANSFORMATION IN GOVERNMENT, FEDERAL DATA INFRASTRUCTURE, AND MORE.

ProgSrvcAccomActy3Grp.Desc: SCIENCE POLICY ENTREPRENEURSHIP AND DAY ONE PROJECT: A PLATFORM FOR SHAPING PUBLIC POLICY THAT DEMOCRATIZES THE POLICY PROCESS BY SUPPORTING INDIVIDUALS ACROSS THE SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY ECOSYSTEM WITH PROMISING IDEAS AND TURNING THEM INTO ACTIONABLE POLICY. IN FY2025, FAS HOSTED THE DAY ONE 2025 SUMMIT, A CULMINATION OF A YEAR-LONG POLICY SPRINT THAT CREATED MORE THAN 200 NONPARTISAN, IMPLEMENTATION READY POLICY PROPOSALS FOR A NEW ADMINISTRATION SPANNING A BROAD RANGE OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY DOMAINS. THIS SUMMIT SHOWCASED THE PROPOSALS, CONVENING MORE THAN 130 PARTICIPANTS, AND LAID THE GROUNDWORK FOR THE NEWLY-LAUNCHED THE CENTER FOR REGULATORY INGENUITY (CRI), A NEW HUB DEDICATED TO APPLYING THE INSIGHTS OF THE GOVERNMENT CAPACITY MOVEMENT TO SPECIFIC, THORNY PROBLEMS THAT REQUIRE A FUNDAMENTAL REIMAGINING OF REGULATION AND GOVERNANCE.

ProgSrvcAccomActyOtherGrp.Desc: RESEARCH, POLICY, AND TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE: ACROSS A WIDE RANGE OF POLICY DOMAINS WITH A SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY DIMENSION, FAS A) PRODUCES RIGOROUS, NONPARTISAN RESEARCH AND ANALYSIS THAT INFORM BOTH POLICYMAKERS AND PUBLIC DISCOURSE, B) GENERATES POLICY PROPOSALS TO INFORM GOVERNMENT AGENDA-SETTING, AND C) PROVIDES TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE TO POLICYMAKERS SEEKING TO ACT ON OUR INSIGHTS AND IDEAS.ADDITIONALLY IN FY2025, FAS EXPANDED BEYOND FEDERAL RESEARCH AND POLICY ANALYSIS BY ACQUIRING METROLAB NETWORK, AN ORGANIZATION WITH SIGNIFICANT REACH AT THE STATE AND LOCAL LEVELS, GIVING FAS THE CAPABILITY TO PROVIDE RESEARCH, POLICY ANALYSIS, AND TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE TO STATE AND LOCAL GOVERNMENTS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE FORM 990 WAS PREPARED BY THE EXTERNAL AUDITORS AND REVIEWED BY THE INTERIM FINANCE DIRECTOR AND CFOO. A COPY OF THE FORM 990 WAS REVIEWED BY THE FINANCE AND INVESTMENT COMMITTEE OF THE BOARD AND CIRCULATED TO ALL CURRENT BOARD DIRECTORS WITH A REQUEST FOR ANY COMMENTS OR SUGGESTIONS PRIOR TO FILING. AFTER ALL COMMENTS WERE RECEIVED AND PROCESSED, A FINAL COPY WAS SENT TO THE ENTIRE BOARD AND SUBSEQUENTLY FILED WITH THE IRS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: EACH BOARD MEMBER, PRINCIPAL OFFICER AND KEY EMPLOYEE SIGNS A STATEMENT WHICH AFFIRMS SUCH PERSON HAS RECEIVED A COPY OF THE CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY, HAS READ AND UNDERSTANDS THE POLICY, HAS AGREED TO COMPLY WITH THE POLICY, AND UNDERSTANDS FAS IS CHARITABLE AND IN ORDER TO MAINTAIN ITS FEDERAL TAX EXEMPTION IT MUST ENGAGE PRIMARILY IN ACTIVITIES WHICH ACCOMPLISH ONE OR MORE OF ITS TAX-EXEMPT PURPOSES. IF A CONFLICT OCCURS, THE ORGANIZATION ADDRESSES THE CONFLICT USING THE FOLLOWING PROCEDURES: AN INTERESTED PERSON MAY MAKE A PRESENTATION AT THE GOVERNING BOARD OR COMMITTEE MEETING, BUT AFTER THE PRESENTATION, HE/SHE LEAVES THE MEETING DURING THE DISCUSSION OF, AND THE VOTE ON, THE TRANSACTION OR ARRANGEMENT INVOLVING THE POSSIBLE CONFLICT OF INTEREST. THE CHAIRPERSON OF THE GOVERNING BOARD OR COMMITTEE, IF APPROPRIATE, APPOINTS A DISINTERESTED PERSON OR COMMITTEE TO INVESTIGATE ALTERNATIVES TO THE PROPOSED TRANSACTION OR ARRANGEMENT. AN INTERESTED PERSON MAY ALSO SUBMIT THE CONFLICT IN WRITING INSTEAD OF MAKING A PRESENTATION. AFTER EXERCISING DUE DILIGENCE, THE GOVERNING BOARD OR COMMITTEE DETERMINES WHETHER FAS CAN OBTAIN WITH REASONABLE EFFORTS A MORE ADVANTAGEOUS TRANSACTION OR ARRANGEMENT FROM A PERSON OR ENTITY THAT WOULD NOT GIVE RISE TO A CONFLICT OF INTEREST. IF A MORE ADVANTAGEOUS TRANSACTION OR ARRANGEMENT IS NOT REASONABLY POSSIBLE UNDER CIRCUMSTANCES NOT PRODUCING A CONFLICT OF INTEREST, THE GOVERNING BOARD OR COMMITTEE DETERMINES BY A MAJORITY VOTE OF THE DISINTERESTED BOARD MEMBERS WHETHER THE TRANSACTION OR ARRANGEMENT IS IN FAS' BEST INTEREST, FOR ITS OWN BENEFIT, AND WHETHER IT IS FAIR AND REASONABLE. IN CONFORMITY WITH THE ABOVE DETERMINATION, IT MAKES ITS DECISION AS TO WHETHER TO ENTER INTO THE TRANSACTION OR ARRANGEMENT. IF THE GOVERNING BOARD OR COMMITTEE HAS REASONABLE CAUSE TO BELIEVE A MEMBER HAS FAILED TO DISCLOSE ACTUAL OR POSSIBLE CONFLICTS OF INTEREST, IT INFORMS THE MEMBER OF THE BASIS FOR SUCH BELIEF AND AFFORDS THE MEMBER AN OPPORTUNITY TO EXPLAIN THE ALLEGED FAILURE TO DISCLOSE. IF, AFTER HEARING THE MEMBER'S RESPONSE AND AFTER MAKING FURTHER INVESTIGATION AS WARRANTED BY THE CIRCUMSTANCES, THE GOVERNING BOARD OR COMMITTEE DETERMINES THE MEMBER HAS FAILED TO DISCLOSE AN ACTUAL OR POSSIBLE CONFLICT OF INTEREST, IT TAKES APPROPRIATE DISCIPLINARY AND CORRECTIVE ACTION.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: CEO'S SALARY IS APPROVED BY BOARD OF DIRECTORS BASED ON COMP STUDY PERFORMED BY THIRD PARTIES EVERY 2-3 YEARS. THE CEO HAS NO RIGHT TO VOTE FOR HIS COMPENSATION. SALARY FOR KEY EMPLOYEES AND OTHER OFFICERS IS APPROVED BY CEO AND HR AND DETERMINE COMPENSATION FOR THE FOLLOWING YEAR USING DATA THAT PROVIDES COMPARABLE COMPENSATION FOR SIMILARLY QUALIFIED PEOPLE IN FUNCTIONALLY COMPARABLE POSITIONS AT SIMILARLY SITUATED ORGANIZATIONS. ALL RECORDS AND INFORMATION OF THE PROCESS ARE DOCUMENTED ACCORDINGLY.
